papers.title_en: Your Teacher Can't Help You Here: Combating Supervision Fidelity Decay in On-Policy Distillation
papers.authors: Yanjiang Liu, Jie Lou, Xinyan Guan, Yuqiu Ji, Hongyu Lin, Ben He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Xing Yu, Yaojie Lu
papers.evidence: 在线策略蒸馏与师生框架
papers.tldr: 在线策略蒸馏中，学生生成前缀变长会导致教师监督保真度衰减（SFD），即教师分布变得不自信且区分度降低，削弱反向KL蒸馏信号。为缓解此问题，本文提出Lookahead Group Reward方法，利用下一步教师置信度评估学生候选token并赋予组归一化奖励，并设计熵触发树注意力机制保持效率。在数学和代码基准上，该方法使7B学生模型的mean@8提升2.57点，长生成任务中在AIME-26上提升4.92点（39k tokens）。工作揭示了长链推理中蒸馏瓶颈并提供了有效解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation transfers reasoning capabilities by training a student model on its own generated trajectories using token-level feedback from a teacher. However, we identify a critical bottleneck, \textbf{Supervision Fidelity Decay (SFD)}: as student-generated prefixes lengthen, the teacher's next-token distribution becomes less confident and less discriminative. Consequently, the teacher-dependent corrective signal in reverse-KL distillation weakens, causing student drift to compound across long reasoning chains. To mitigate SFD, we introduce \textbf{Lookahead Group Reward (\ours{})}. Building on the insight that next-step teacher confidence reflects the discriminative strength of future reverse-KL supervision, \ours{} evaluates the student's top-K candidate tokens by the teacher confidence they induce at the subsequent step and assigns a group-normalized reward. To maintain computational efficiency, we further design an entropy-triggered tree-attention mechanism. Across six math and code benchmarks, \ours{} improves mean@8 by \textbf{2.57} points over OPD for a 7B student, with gains increasing in longer-generation and reaching +\textbf{4.92} points on AIME-26 at 39k tokens.

papers.title_en: Trust-Region Behavior Blending for On-Policy Distillation
papers.authors: Daniil Plyusov, Alexey Gorbatovski, Alexey Malakhov, Nikita Balagansky, Boris Shaposhnikov, Daria Korotyshova, Daniil Gavrilov
papers.evidence: 在线策略蒸馏的预热方法
papers.tldr: 在线策略蒸馏通过学生自身轨迹训练避免分布偏移，但早期学生策略质量低，教师监督效果差。本文提出信任域行为混合（TRB）预热方法，在KL信任域内将学生早期rollout策略替换为最接近教师的行为策略，并保持反向KL损失不变，随后通过退火KL预算逐渐恢复学生策略。在数学推理蒸馏任务（如GSM8K、MATH）上，TRB取得最佳平均性能，显著优于在线和离线基线。该方法简单高效，解决了在线蒸馏早期样本质量瓶颈，可广泛应用于知识蒸馏场景。
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy while matching a stronger teacher. This addresses the prefix mismatch of offline distillation, but early student rollouts can still be poor, placing teacher supervision on weak or low-quality prefixes. We propose Trust-Region behavior Blending (TRB), a warmup method that replaces the early rollout policy with the closest-to-teacher behavior policy inside a student-centered KL trust region, while keeping the per-prefix reverse-KL OPD loss unchanged. The KL budget is annealed to zero, so training returns to pure student rollouts after warmup. Across two math-reasoning distillation settings, TRB attains the strongest average among the compared methods.

papers.title_en: Are Full Rollouts Necessary for On-Policy Distillation?
papers.authors: Yaocheng Zhang, Jiajun Chai, Songjun Tu, Yuqian Fu, Xiaohan Wang, Wei Lin, Guojun Yin, Qichao Zhang, Yuanheng Zhu, Dongbin Zhao
papers.evidence: 研究在线策略蒸馏中的轨迹长度
papers.tldr: 在线策略蒸馏通常需要完整轨迹rollout，但计算开销大且早期训练时尾部教师反馈不可靠。本文提出两种rollout长度控制策略：渐进式POPD逐步扩展长度，截断式TOPD永久使用可靠截断。在数学推理任务中，POPD提升训练效率3倍，TOPD仅用10%的rollout长度即达到同等性能。工作揭示了rollout长度是OPD效率的关键瓶颈，为高效蒸馏提供了简单实用的方案。
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher feedback along rollouts generated by the student and has emerged as a promising post-training paradigm for long-horizon reasoning. However, standard OPD typically generates full rollouts during training, which is computationally expensive and may expose the student to unreliable teacher feedback at late rollout positions, especially during early training. We identify the rollout horizon as a key bottleneck in OPD that substantially impacts training efficiency. Unlike Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), OPD does not require a complete trajectory or a final answer reward to provide learning signals. This observation suggests that full rollouts may not always be necessary for effective OPD. Motivated by this insight, we propose two simple horizon-control strategies: Progressive OPD (POPD), which gradually expands the rollout horizon during training, and Truncated OPD (TOPD), which permanently performs distillation on reliable truncated rollouts. Experiments on mathematical reasoning show that POPD improves the training efficiency of OPD by up to 3$\times$, while TOPD matches OPD performance using only 10\% of the rollout horizon, leading to substantial wall-clock and memory reductions. These results demonstrate that controlling the rollout horizon offers a simple and practical path to more efficient OPD.

papers.title_en: Efficient and Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Framework for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Ha Manh Bui, Metod Jazbec, Eric Nalisnick, Anqi Liu
papers.evidence: 离线到在线RL中基于扩散的策略蒸馏以提高样本效率
papers.tldr: 离线到在线强化学习面临分布偏移问题。提出DUAL框架，利用扩散模型先验知识蒸馏快速采样策略和转移模型，结合Laplace近似与状态转移检测量化不确定性以平衡探索与利用。实验表明DUAL在多个环境下提升在线期望回报。该框架为O2O-RL提供了有效且不确定性感知的解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (O2O-RL) leverages an offline, pre-trained policy to minimize costly online interactions. Although data-efficient, O2O-RL is susceptible to shifts between offline and online distributions. Existing work aims to mitigate the harm of this shift by finetuning the policy on trajectory data sampled from a diffusion model. Inspired by this line of work, we propose DUAL: an efficient \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{U}ncertainty-\textbf{A}ware framework for offline-to-online reinforcement \textbf{L}earning. DUAL utilizes the prior knowledge of the diffusion model to distill a fast-sampling diffusion actor policy and transition model in the offline phase. DUAL also employs a Laplace approximation and distance transition-state-shift detection, thereby using uncertainty quantification to improve exploration versus exploitation in the online phase. We formally show that our actor loss with the Laplace approximation provides a proxy for a principled estimate of epistemic uncertainty. Empirically, DUAL improves the online expected return over O2O-RL baselines across multiple settings and environments.

papers.title_en: The Flip Side of RLHF: On-Policy Feedback for Reward Model Self-Supervised Improvement
papers.authors: Xiaobo Wang, Tong Wu, Min Tang, Jiaqi Li, Qi Liu, Zilong Zheng
papers.evidence: 用于奖励模型自改进的在线策略反馈
papers.tldr: RLHF中奖励模型训练受限于静态偏好数据，随着策略更新而失效。提出SAVE框架，利用值函数作为自适应锚点对在线策略响应评分，通过对比目标更新RM。在六个基准上验证，SAVE提升RM训练效果，并与GRPO、RLOO、GSPO三种RL算法及不同策略骨干保持一致改进。
papers.abstract_en: Building strong reward models (RMs) for language model alignment is bottlenecked by the cost and difficulty of acquiring diverse and reliable preference data from human annotation or judge models. It is dramatically worse as the policy evolves beyond the static RM training. Therefore, we propose SAVE (Self-supervised reward model improvement via Value-Anchored On-policy feedback), a framework that grades on-policy responses as feedback by using the value function for on-policy RM training. SAVE naturally converts the reward-graded on-policy responses into supervision with a prompt-specific value head as an adaptive anchor. It computes RM advantages and filters ambiguous samples to update the RM via a contrastive objective. The effectiveness of SAVE for enhancing RM training is strongly validated through rigorous empirical evaluation across six diverse benchmarks. It achieves outperforming results across all datasets while maintaining consistent improvements across three RL algorithms (GRPO, RLOO, GSPO) and different policy backbones.
